title: Overview first: the closed event tree, code marks, All code, ooRexxDoc
summary: From v0.11 (designer) and v0.3 (Object Editor), after feedback from Rony G. Flatscher (start collapsed and drill down; DrDialog-like view of which parts have code; all the code in one place; ooRexxDoc as tooltips) and Josep Maria Blasco. Designer: the event tree starts closed; each control shows its count of coded events ("3 ●"); ▸ opens it; the selected control is open; Open all, Close all, With code only. On the form, a control with code carries a blue count mark (.dz-code); clicking it opens the control in the tree. All code (OodDesign~allCode) shows every event and method the user wrote, in form order, each under a heading ("@@" TAB kind TAB control TAB event TAB method TAB thread, then the code); a heading opens that piece. Object Editor: inherited members are grouped by defining class, Object and Class closed; doc-comments are read by OxDocs.cls with the Rexx Parser (option DocComments All): the summary is the tooltip, the whole text the doc box.
invariants: The page counts and draws; ooRexx answers the code (allCode) and the docs (OxWorkspace~docsOf, OxDocs~docsOf): no Rexx is parsed in JavaScript.
A doc-comment belongs to the directive right after it, with only blanks between. Kinds: CLASS, METHOD, ATTRIBUTE, CONSTANT, ROUTINE; a class-side member's name ends " class".
OxDocs and the parser load on first use (loadPackage), not with the editor.
The Object Editor loads a file with its prolog blanked (so the prolog does not run); docs for the file's own classes are read from the text as written, or a class's doc-comment in the prolog is lost.
Browser tests that pick an event open its control first (dztest pick_event); tests that read a control's text read its body (> div:first-child), not the mark.
